+# Source gate: 5100021 / k403,b
+
+The exact pinned record and full prior OPEN-TRIAGE report were read at dataset revision37e53eabe540fb458758e198be61634bd02ee008. Both source Table5 editions were inspected visually: arXiv2004.12497v11 printedp7, and the final Arnold Mathematical Journal7(2021) paper printedp348. They match the pinned statement.
+
+## Exact target
+
+For a strictly nested nondegenerate confocal ellipse pair, take a primitive billiard orbit with least period divisible by4. The original-polygon pedal is formed by perpendicular projections of a fixed focus onto the original chord side lines. The original-polygon antipedal has sides through the original vertices perpendicular to the vertex-minus-focus vectors, with vertices given by consecutive line intersections. Both areas are ordered signed shoelace areas. The target is the product A_M A_M^*, for either focus. The outer polygon and inner contact polygon are not substituted.
+
+The origin/odd row is k403,a. It is not part of this target; the initial assignment shorthand was corrected against the pinned record and both complete primary tables. Reflection and traversal conventions, finiteness of antipedal intersections, and any zero-area cases will be addressed before claiming a theorem. A product does not require division by either area.
+
+## Prior-attempt gate
+
+The recovered campaign inventory lists this ID queued0/5 with no earlier Alec/campaign attempt. Exact-ID and k403 all-state PR searches return none; matching branch and target-path commit-history searches return none. Local all-ref target history and the related-target group file contain no match. These are limited gate checks, not a novelty certificate. Nearby pedal/antipedal work must be credited if used; no full exact-target theorem was inferred from a neighboring label.
+
+## Current literature and budget
+
+A fresh focused search recovered the exact primary table and related focal pedal/antipedal work, but no checked published general-N proof of this exact row. This is not proof of current openness or novelty. The arXivv11 is dated29October2020; the final companion is2021. Full PDFs and source images remain local reading material.
+
+Source retrieval itself is not a substantive author turn. The first proof attempt will begin with direct small-period algebra and source-definition checks before a general Jacobi route. Five substantive turns are required if unresolved; a full proof/counterexample may stop earlier for separate independent review. No PR before that review. QUEUE regeneration is not used.
